title: What LLM Trading Agents Actually Do in Production: A Six-Month, Population-Scale Record from Two Fleets
abstract: arXiv:2609.05663v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a continuous, population-scale measurement record of autonomous language-model trading agents operating in production across two systems with one design lineage: DX Terminal Pro (3,505 user-funded vaults trading real ETH in Base memecoin markets for 21 days, February to March 2026) and the DXAP live alpha fleet (500 to 599 user-created agents all-history, 91 to 117 concurrently active, trading Hyperliquid perpetuals, June to August 2026). The record spans roughly six months, 7.5M single-model invocations with about 300K onchain actions, and a further 231,638 multi-tool turns producing 14,596 fills. Four findings carry the paper. First, the operating layer determines behavior more than anything written in strategy text: a risk slider explains leverage (+0.425 per level), agent fixed effects absorb 60% of variance, and a leaderboard render boundary causally routes selection (regression discontinuity 1.75x at the top-3 cut). translated_title: 大语言模型交易智能体在生产环境中的真实行为：来自两个智能体集群的六个月、种群规模记录
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一份对生产环境中自主运行的语言模型交易智能体进行的持续性、种群规模的测量记录，涵盖两个具有同一设计传承的系统：DX Terminal Pro（3,505个用户注资的金库，在Base迷因币市场交易真实ETH，持续21天，2026年2月至3月）以及DXAP实时Alpha集群（500至599个用户创建的智能体的全历史记录，91至117个智能体同时活跃，交易Hyperliquid永续合约，2026年6月至8月）。该记录跨越约六个月，包含约750万次单模型调用与约30万次链上操作，以及231,638次多工具轮次并产生了14,596次成交。论文的核心在于四项发现。第一，运行层对行为的决定作用超过策略文本中的任何内容：一个风险滑块即可解释杠杆水平（每级+0.425），智能体固定效应吸收了60%的方差，而排行榜渲染边界因果性地引导了选择过程（在前三名截断处的断点回归系数为1.75倍）……
tldr: 本文首次提供了两个生产级大语言模型交易智能体系统六个月的种群规模持续测量记录，发现运行层机制（如风险滑块、排行榜渲染边界）比策略文本更能决定智能体的实际交易行为。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first six-month, population-scale measurement record of LLM trading agents across two production fleets, revealing that the operating layer—such as risk sliders and leaderboard render boundaries—determines agent behavior far more than anything written in strategy text.
